subject: Trading
title: Bitcoin Pizza Day
description: Learn Bitcoin Pizza Day in one minute.

hook.text: On May 22, 2010, a programmer paid 10,000 bitcoin for two pizzas. Today that would be worth hundreds of millions.

buildup.text: Laszlo Hanyecz posted on a forum offering BTC for pizza delivery. Someone accepted the deal.

discovery.text: It was the first real-world purchase with Bitcoin—proof that this digital token had real economic value.

twist.text: Those coins would be worth over $600 million at Bitcoin's all-time high. The most expensive meal in history.

climax.text: Every currency starts somewhere. Bitcoin started with a pizza that proved people would trade it for goods.

punchline.text: Two pizzas launched a trillion-dollar asset.

quiz.question: Why is Bitcoin Pizza Day significant?
options: The first real-world purchase with Bitcoin proved its economic value
